name: Medical Icons
about: Medical Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 144 icons designed by Samuel Frémondière. Covers common healthcare, pharmacy and medical symbols for health apps and websites. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Medical Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 144 Medical Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: What symbols do Medical Icons include?
faqs.a: Common healthcare, pharmacy and medical symbols for health apps and websites. Search the set for the symbol you need – every icon downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP.

faqs.q: How do I use Medical Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Medical Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 144 icons in the Medical Icons set, designed by Samuel Frémondière. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Medical Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
